Name: ReAnimate (Instant Start)
Author: Nyaughty, fork by MattOnTheStack
Punchline: ReAnimate, plus instant starts when moving idles between /cpose slots.
Description: A fork of Nyaughty's ReAnimate. Animation Swap can make the start transition instant when an idle has no start of its own, and default-idle mods can be moved onto numbered /cpose slots. Everything else is ReAnimate as it is: turn your current pose into an idle pose with a single click.
Changelog:
Add instant start for idle swaps, fix default-idle swaps

Fork of ReAnimate as "ReAnimate (Instant Start)" (InternalName
ReAnimateInstantStart) so it installs next to the official plugin.

- Animation Swap: when the animation has no start of its own, the target
  /cpose slot's vanilla start is cut to one frame (C009 duration 1), so the
  idle begins at once. A radio choice keeps the vanilla transition instead.
- Default idles (resident/idle, and the sit/ground-sit/doze bases) can be
  swapped onto numbered slots: a single-file animation now fills a slot's
  loop, and stance bases are offered their own stance's slots.
- GitHub Actions builds every push, publishes a release and updates
  repo.json on the dist branch.
- Offline checks cover the instant-start patch on a real vanilla start.
